entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Create IAlertManager so users can replace the behavior of our AlertManager #33266
    .NET 11.0-preview1
  • RadioButtonGroup not working with CollectionView #33264
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `maui/inflight/current` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #33261
  • [Android] picked images end up with unexpected "_processed" suffix #33258
  • MSIX Publish Fails in Visual Studio When Project References Multi-Target MAUI Class Library #33255

Closed

  • [Testing] Rework the Catalyst Test Runner so that it will pass in the next test as a startup argument vs navigating by keyboard #30285
    Backlog
  • The SearchHandler is not rendering in the middle of Shell Title View Or Shell Navigation Bar On Windows App using MAUI #15307
  • iOS: Flyout Menu Backdrop Area does not Readjust on Orientation Change #21105
    Backlog
  • Slider thumb lags behind finger on iOS 26+ #32926
  • Development Android on Linux #33235
  • Problem with FilePicker #33105

    community ✨
